prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, early 20s goddess, violin hip hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a sharply cinched waist rises out of hips that sweep outward in a single smooth violin-shaped curve, the hips and thick rounded thighs flaring many times wider than the waist and dominating her silhouette from the front and side, a firm high rounded rear, a full round bust balancing the curve above; the line from waist to hip to thigh is one long unbroken curve; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, high ponytail jet-black hair — full body clear crystal glass fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid glass curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted glass sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — transparent pale aqua-tinted glass across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, the surrounding light passing through the body and bending into bright refracted rainbows and caustic patterns across every section, VIVID bright edge highlights along each joint, high-gloss polished glass with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Pose: standing in a wide stance facing the camera straight on, both hands resting on her flared hips, her legs fully in view — most extreme violin hip hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Cracks: the clear glass body shows weathering in only two places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her left thigh, and one chipped-off piece at her right upper arm, where the broken edge reveals the raw frosted white glass with a rough sugary surface inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the clear glass is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, ankle-strap platform stiletto sandals in white leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved clear glass right down to the shoes.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her forearm is wide, made of the same clear glass with a high polish.
Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face, ears and entire neck are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Korean woman (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: thick black eyeliner, extremely long dramatic false lashes top and bottom, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy peach-pink lips. Her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved clear glass.

Background: a mirrored cube room with mirrors on all four walls, the ceiling and a glossy black floor, thin hot-pink neon LED strips running along every corner so the pink lines multiply into an endless glowing lattice in all directions, her figure repeated in the lattice from every side, the whole floor clearly visible and in focus, lit by the pink neon and soft light with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — carved material everywhere from the collarbones to the ankles. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, so the extreme heel height reads at a glance. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, the reflections being part of that same photograph. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
